answer: Got it — stored as a standing rule: library crates use `thiserror`, binaries use `anyhow`, never swapped. I'll apply this in future work on this codebase.

memories.content: In this codebase, library crates must use thiserror for their error types, and binaries must use anyhow for theirs — never the reverse.
